title: Localized tame root chart and transverse generic factor
statement: Let $S$ be a normal integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme, $c:C\to S$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres, $\sigma:S\to C$ a section, and $G$ a finite group with order invertible in $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $q:C_\eta\to\operatorname{Spec}k(S)$ and $j:C_\eta\to C$ exhibit the generic fibre [def-pc-fibre-product], with a section $s_\eta$ satisfying $q s_\eta=1$ and $j s_\eta=\sigma a_\eta$. Let $Z\to C_\eta$ be a finite etale $G$-torsor without any rational-point assumption. Let $U\subset S$ contain $\eta$, let $P\to C_U$ be finite etale, and let $j_U:C_\eta\to C_U$ and $\psi:Z\to P$ exhibit its generic restriction, with $i_Uj_U=j$. Let $s\notin U$ be such that every $t\notin U$ specializing to $s$ equals $s$. Put $a:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to S$, $L=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$, $l:L\to C$, and let $N\to C$ be the concrete relative normalization of $P\to C_U\to C$. Let $\tau=(a\sigma,1):\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to L$ be the induced section. Assume $\mathcal O_{S,s}$ is a discrete valuation ring and that $n:N\times_C L\to L$ is finite. For each point $x$ of $N\times_C L$ with $n(x)=\tau(\mathfrak m_{S,s})$, put $B=\mathcal O_{N\times_C L,x}$ and $J=\mathfrak m_{L,n(x)}B$. There exist a commutative local ring $R$, $f\in\mathfrak m_R$ and $e>0$. Put $D=R[T]/(T^e-f)$, concretely the AdjoinRoot quotient. There exist a maximal ideal $\mathfrak p$ of $D$ and a flat local map $\beta:B\to E$, where $E=D_{\mathfrak p}$ is the localization at $\mathfrak p$. For the composite $i_P:R\to D\to E$ one has $J E=\mathfrak m_R E$. No locality of the entire ring $D$, locality of $R\to D$, or identification of $D_{\mathfrak p}$ with $D$ is asserted. There also exist a discrete valuation ring $A'$ (a nonfield local principal ideal domain), its fraction field $K$, an element $\varpi\in A'$ with $\mathfrak m_{A'}=(\varpi)$, a unit $\pi\in K^\times$ with $\pi=\varpi$ under the fraction-field embedding, and $b:\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k(S)$. There is an open immersion $g:\operatorname{Spec}(K[T]/(T^e-\pi))\to Z\times_{C_\eta}\operatorname{Spec}K$ along $s_\eta b$, whose composite with the projection to $\operatorname{Spec}K$ is the canonical structural map. No maximal-ideal formula for $D$, power-membership assertion for its root, or integer-valued valuation is part of this statement.

proof.text: Obtain an affine etale root product chart using an actual trait uniformizer, retaining its structural identity.
Localize the chart at a point over x and y and select its factor k. This gives R0,f0,P,beta and the extended maximal ideal identity.
Apply the generic-section construction to that same chart and the selected k. Combine its generic factor witnesses with the localized stalk witnesses; the exponent e_k is common to both.

theorem GaloisCover.stalk_normalization_trait_section_localized_root_chart {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (σ : S ⟶ C) (hσ : σ ≫ c = 𝟙 S)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (sη : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Cη) (hsq : sη ≫ q = 𝟙 _)
    (hsj : sη ≫ j = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S) ≫ σ)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη)
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U)
    (jU : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (ψ : Z.P ⟶ PA.obj.left) (hjU : jU ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = j)
    (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π PA.obj.hom jU)
    (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s)
    (hdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a)
    let τ : Spec (S.presheaf.stalk s) ⟶ pullback c a :=
      pullback.lift (a ≫ σ) (𝟙 _) (by simp [Category.assoc, hσ])
    IsFinite n → ∀ x : (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
      (pullback.fst c a) : Scheme.{u}),
      n x = τ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (S.presheaf.stalk s)) →
      let B := (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
        (pullback.fst c a)).presheaf.stalk x
      let J := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pullback c a).presheaf.stalk (n x))).map
        (n.stalkMap x).hom
      ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsLocalRing R) (f : R) (e : ℕ),
        0 < e ∧ f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ∧
        let p := (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ e - Polynomial.C f
        let D := AdjoinRoot p
        ∃ (P : Ideal D) (hP : P.IsMaximal),
          letI : P.IsPrime := hP.isPrime
          let E := Localization.AtPrime P
          ∃ (β : B →+* E), IsLocalHom β ∧ β.Flat ∧
          J.map β = (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map
            ((algebraMap D E).comp (AdjoinRoot.of p)) ∧
          ∃ (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsDomain A) (_ : IsDiscreteValuationRing A)
            (K : Type u) (_ : Field K) (_ : Algebra A K) (_ : IsFractionRing A K)
            (ϖ : A) (π : Kˣ) (b : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ Spec S.functionField),
            IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A = Ideal.span {ϖ} ∧ (π : K) = algebraMap A K ϖ ∧
            ∃ g : Spec (CommRingCat.of
                (AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial K) ^ e - Polynomial.C (π : K)))) ⟶
                pullback Z.π (b ≫ sη),
              IsOpenImmersion g ∧
              g ≫ pullback.snd Z.π (b ≫ sη) =
                Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K
                  (AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial K) ^ e -
                    Polynomial.C (π : K)))))
